backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC business-combination events are read from EDGAR submissions cache recent filings for forms S-4, S-4/A, DEFM14A, PREM14A, SC TO-I, SC TO-T, SC 14D9, and SC 14D9/A. The signal date is the filing date unless the SEC acceptance timestamp is after 16:00, in which case it is the next trading day. Candidates must show signal-day price absorption before next-open paper entry: non-negative daily return, return minus SPY >= 0.5%, close location >= 0.56, volume ratio >= 0.75, realized vol <= 12%, ret20 excess vs SPY >= -5%, price >= $10, and ADV20 >= $50M. Paper entry is the next available open with entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260617-011: Rejected SEC text contract economics and explicitly excluded merger/tender text from contract parsing. This run avoids text regexes and tests the structured SEC form family directly.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-023: Rejected SEC offering/prospectus absorption. This run excludes generic S-1/S-3/F-3/424B financing forms and tests business-combination registration/proxy/tender forms.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-027: Rejected non-management proxy-pressure absorption. This run is not activist/proxy-pressure provenance; it uses issuer or deal-party business-combination and tender-offer forms.
2_history_check.exp-20260618-001: Rejected 8-K Item 2.05 restructuring absorption on thin sample. This run does not retry 8-K item codes or restructuring economics.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: M&A/tender SEC forms are a free PIT submissions surface with enough broad-universe coverage and are materially different from rejected financing/proxy/restructuring/accounting fields; the main risk is that deal economics are already priced or capped before next-open execution.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing business-combination/tender filing rows, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC business-combination/tender forms, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
